scientific_integrity: A complete finite-sample combinatorial argument establishes the infinite family; independent exact finite enumeration and arithmetic checks are supplemental. Published one-run enumeration and part-count information are acknowledged as prior foundations.
scientific_limitations: Uniform fixed-content binary words with at least two ones and at least one zero. The TP2 result applies to count of one-runs and count of singleton one-runs; higher total positivity, other lengths, nonuniform strings and location statistics are not claimed. Historical priority is not exhaustively resolved.
title: Likelihood-ratio ordering of singleton success runs under fixed composition
